units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 1:23">Tosef. Sabb. I, 23</cite> <he>נותנין ק׳ לעין וכ׳</he> you may put collyrium on the eye on the eve of the Sabbath &c.; <cite ref="Shabbat 18a:5">Sabb. 18ᵃ</cite>; Y. ib. I, 3ᵈ bot. <he>קילורית</he>. Ib. VII, 10ᵇ bot. <he>ההן דגבל … עפר קילורין וכ׳</he> he who kneads … powder for collyrium (on the Sabbath) &c.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 16">Lev. R. s. 16</cite>, beg. (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 3:16">Is. III, 16</cite>) they painted their eyes <he>בקולרית אדומה</he> Ar. (ed. <he>בקולריא</he>, some ed. <he>בקוֹלִּירָא</he>) with red collyrium; Pesik. Vattom., p. 132ᵃ <he>בקולרית</he>; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 4:18">Lam. R. to IV, 15</cite> <he>בקִלּוּרִית</he>.

<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 8:4">Deut. R. s. 8</cite> <he>ק׳ לעינים וכ׳</he> the Law is a salve for the eyes, for it is written (<cite ref="Psalms 19:9">Ps. XIX, 9</cite>) &c.; Midr. Till. to Ps. l. c.; Yalk. ib. 675; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 12:3">Lev. R. s. 12</cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 8:1:14">Y. Sabb. VIII, 11ᵇ</cite> top <he>מים … את הקולורית</he> water as much as is required for rubbing collyrium; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="S00972"><he>קִילּוּרִין</he></cite>. Bab.
<cite ref="Shabbat 108b:12">Sabb. 108ᵇ</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>לישדר … מהנך ק׳ וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>קִילּוּרֵי</he>) please send me some of Mar Samuel’s eye-salves.

<cite ref="Shabbat 108b:12">Ib.</cite> <he>טובה … מכל ק׳ שבעולם</he> better than all eye-salves in the world is a drop of cold water (on the eye) in the morning and bathing hands and feet in the evening.
